frozen_at: 2026-09-09 (before any pilot execution; first execution 2026-09-09 on billy-laptop)

world_binding.world: research/fna5-routing-first-refusal-v1/fna5_world.py (PR #219, merged at base commit; imported read-only, never modified)
world_binding.splits: frozen md5 buckets in fna5_world.split_of: DEV <=3, EVAL 4..7, DRIFT 8..9 (40/40/20 by construction)
world_binding.drift_mutation: replicated exactly from fna5.py apply_drift: remove window:60, add sample:48 on anchor drift:0, theta1 re-drawn, theta2 +0.05, scan_version_mult 1.6, index rebuilt

host_harness_H.router: SUPERSEDED by AMENDMENT 1: A2 cost-model router (#219 CostModelArm) fitted on DEV identification records, charged identically to every arm; identical rule for every arm
host_harness_H.per_query_charge: feature extraction work + router work + exec + verify (+ on failure: classification inference + repair continuation)

repair_table.SELECTOR_METHOD_MISMATCH: retry cheapest applicable different-family approximation by declared cost estimate; if it also fails, scan
repair_table.NO_CLASSIFIER: scan immediately (portfolio-recovery default; floor, never a result)

maintenance_refresh.trigger: arm's stale flags >= 8 within the drift window
maintenance_refresh.price: identification work of executing every applicable instance + verify over the first 24 drift-window failures (deterministic precompute; billed once to the triggering arm)
maintenance_refresh.effect: SUPERSEDED by AMENDMENT 1: router re-fitted once on those maintenance-window identification records; identical rule for every arm; arms differ only in trigger timing

host_harness_H.consumption_note: classes STALE and NOISE share the per-query repair (scan) and differ exactly in refresh timing; SELECTOR differs per-query; both consumption paths are measured

responsibility_ground_truth_frozen_order: STALE_DECLARED_MODEL iff drift regime AND declared point-prediction (declared centres, neutral u=0.5) says PASS AND realized outcome with true u is FAIL AND binding-clause slack gap > 0.04
else SELECTOR_METHOD_MISMATCH iff some applicable different-family non-exact instance would PASS under realized laws AND its declared cost estimate < scan's
legal_information_surface: the 12 world features (log2_n, disp, alias, type_entropy, n_applicable, rarest_postings, min_window_w, mean_w, skew_w, ndup, task_flag, scan_cost_est)

failed-attempt trace facts: family, param, per-clause slacks under DECLARED centres with neutral noise, declared cost estimate of failed instance, cheapest different-family declared cost, applicability counts, catalogue_version flag (pre/post drift, environment-observable)
FORBIDDEN: u(q), realized thetas, realized outcomes of unexecuted alternatives, split identity, ground-truth responsibility

arms.R1_GUARDED_DECLARED: Bayes-style rule on declared centres; gamma noise-guard 0.15 on pass-probability bands; zero label acquisition; structurally cannot assert STALE (declared==its estimate, gap identically 0); authored bytes charged
arms.R2_CALIBRATED_BAYES: realized constants re-estimated from DEV failure labels (feasible-interval moment estimation); same gamma guard; STALE assertable post-drift via declared-vs-estimated contradiction with gap > 0.04; acquisition charged at in-world identification price
arms.R3_CART_TREE: CART, gini, depth <= 3, min-leaf 8, dev-trained on the same charged labels; deterministic seeded tie-breaking
arms.INCUMBENT_NEURAL_REF: pure-stdlib seeded MLP, legal surface (standardized) -> 16 tanh -> 3 softmax, SGD lr 0.05, 60 epochs, batch 16, seeded init; same charged labels; stands in for the model-supplied incumbent CLASS at pilot scale (declared limitation; never a frontier-model claim)
arms.ORACLE_LATENT: ground-truth classifier (exact latents); ceiling diagnostic, never a result
arms.SHUFFLE_NULL: seeded permutation of the strongest replacement arm's EVAL predictions (marginals kept, information destroyed)

sufficiency_frozen.rule: arm sufficient iff protected-EVAL failure accuracy >= incumbent accuracy - 0.03 AND mean whole-chain charged cost per failed query (continuation + inference + amortized acquisition and maintenance) <= incumbent x 1.05 AND neural invocations for the capability == 0 (structural)

terminal_mapping.none sufficient, ORACLE_LATENT meets inc: NO_FUNCTIONAL_PARITY_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION (+ACQUISITION_COST_DOMINATES side-flag if the gap closes with uncharged labels; +REPRESENTATION_INSUFFICIENT if even ORACLE cannot meet the bar)

causal_gate_execution: the gate runner evaluates all 10 clauses of #214 section 5 with concrete evidence (see results json gate object); clause 6 substitution check = constant-NOISE substitution of the strongest arm's EVAL predictions

amendments.recorded: 2026-09-09, BEFORE any scored pilot execution (only tiny smoke runs had occurred and they produced zero failures on every split; no outcome of the scored run was accessed)
amendments.change: host router switched from the zero-fit analytic-guarded rule to #219's A2_COST_MODEL (CostModelArm) fitted on DEV identification records; maintenance refresh re-fits the A2 on the frozen 24-failure identification window; classifier label acquisition is reconstructed from the same identification table with a counterfactual failure-restricted price (no execution double-charged)
amendments.rationale: the analytic router's failure stream is too sparse to exercise the classification capability: #219's published FNA5_RESULTS_V1.json reports A1 fallback_rate 0.0043 on EVAL vs A2_COST_MODEL 0.1008 (parent-published numbers, not outcomes of this pilot); zero failures would make every arm vacuously sufficient
amendments.charging: router identification+fit price is harness cost common to all arms (reported once in world.harness_router_price, cancels in every arm-vs-arm comparison); refresh price is billed to the triggering arm; classifier label price remains arm-specific (R1 pays zero)

amendments.recorded: 2026-09-09, AFTER the first scored execution had been inspected (outcome access had occurred); recorded before any re-run and before any terminal was accepted or reported
amendments.change: mechanical harness-defect fix: each arm now runs on its own freshly built seed-identical world (the drift mutation is applied in-stream by run_harness, so sequential arms on one shared world object contaminated each other's DEV/EVAL streams with compounded drift); SHUFFLE_NULL augmented with majority_class_rate because permuting a constant predictor is a no-op
amendments.justification: the FREEZE already declares the harness held constant and the router identical across arms; the shared-world defect violated that declaration (EVAL failure counts ranged 93..363 by run order). No threshold, arm, terminal mapping, or ground-truth rule was changed; this amendment enforces the frozen design rather than altering it
amendments.verification: results carry eval_failure_qid_digest per arm; the held-constant test asserts all arms share one digest

declared_limitations_before_outcomes: one authored world (E1/L1 evidence class, #219 authorship); responsibility classes are that world's physics
incumbent is a seeded MLP stand-in for the incumbent class, not a frontier model
three responsibility classes, not the full #208 section-6 taxonomy
the pilot proves the protocol executable and reports a pilot-scoped terminal; it licenses no deployment and no #208-scale claim
